name: t1_literal_credential_dump
label: true_positive
description: A credential dumping tool run under its original filename, from the user's download directory, with its documented arguments and no obfuscation.
detectable_as: Process name, command line, or file hash. Every one of them.
why_hard: It is not. An adversary who renames the binary defeats a name-only detection, which is why tier 3 exists.
